# Reach Social Case Studies

> Operator playbooks from Reach Social — real TikTok Shop wins, framework-named and anonymized where required.

## Case studies

- [Daily Ad Budget +125%. $10K GMV in Four Days of June.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/controlled-ad-scale-food-bev/): Daily ad budget $1,125/day; $10K+ GMV in 4 days
- [Three Weeks of Dead GMV Max Ads, Fixed in One Reset. +112% the Next Week.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/gmv-max-reconnect-fix-food-beverage/): GMV Max fixed; +112% GMV WoW
- [$500 In, $3,500 Out. 600% ROI, and the Campaign Was Only Half Done.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/negotiated-retainer-flip-health-wellness/): 600% ROI at campaign halfway point
- [GMV Max Doubled in One Promo Week. And ROI Went Up With It.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/peak-demand-gmv-scale-oral-care/): +111% GMV Max WoW in promo week
- [A $30K Monthly Goal, Cleared 10 Days Early. $33K and the Month Wasn't Over.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/seeding-stack-beat-health-wellness-supplements/): $33K GMV, goal cleared 10 days early
- [A $70K Goal Hit $79K. Through a Constant Stream of Platform Violations.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/violation-resilient-gmv-growth-pet-supplies/): $79K GMV vs $70K goal
- [Six Figures in 26 Days. One Milestone Month on TikTok Shop.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/gmv-milestone-stack-food-bev/): $100K GMV in 26 days
- [Two Flat Months, Then the Highest GMV Yet. Without Spending More.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/affiliate-sampling-refinement-baby-maternity/): $127K → $150K+ GMV MTD, highest month yet
- [GMV 3.3× in One Month. Affiliates Drove 82% of It.](https://reachsocial.co/casestudies/affiliate-reactivation-system-personal-care/): 3.3× GMV MoM, 82% affiliate-driven
